name: @fungi.computer/computer
author: Levi <levi@technomancy.dev>
description: Cloudflare Computer host for one durable Fungi Computer

scripts.lint: eslint src test container scripts --max-warnings=0 && oxlint --config ../../oxlint.config.ts --deny-warnings src test container scripts
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-daemon.mjs
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:fleet-native && node test/files-rpc.native.mjs && node test/port-proof.mjs && node test/terminal-container-proof.mjs && node test/fuse-startup-proof.mjs && node test/container-resource-proof.mjs && node test/runtime-proof.mjs && node test/process-schema-proof.mjs && node test/process-proof.mjs && node test/terminal-proof.mjs && pnpm run test:app-method-execution && pnpm run test:execution-lifecycle
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/egress-policy.test.mjs test/preview.test.mjs test/fleet.test.mjs test/proof-worker.test.mjs test/workspace-sync.test.mjs test/files-patch.test.mjs test/exec-output.test.mjs && node --test test/seam-signature.test.mjs test/local-backend-replay.test.mjs test/machine-link-reopen-replay.test.mjs test/computer-backends.test.mjs test/terminal-welcome.test.mjs test/on-box-vm.test.mjs && node test/terminal-protocol.test.mjs && node test/container-policy.test.mjs && node test/files-adapter-proof.mjs && node test/operation-record-proof.mjs && node test/process-inventory-proof.mjs

docs.reason: Computer runtime owns no generated API documentation surface

pack.reason: Computer runtime is bundled into a container image, not independently packed

smoke.reason: The real Worker-runtime test exercises the full container composition

stranger.reason: Computer runtime is a container image owner, not an installable library consumer fixture
